title: PresentationSlideLayouts
description: Reusable slide layout definitions describing title, body, columns, metrics, and supporting regions.

defaults.description: Canvas geometry and per-region-type defaults shared by every layout.

themeColorRef.description: Address of a color in PresentationColorTheme. Scalars are named directly; accents are addressed as <accent>.<channel>.

layoutDefaults.description: Canvas geometry and per-region-type defaults. The single owner of canvas dimensions and outer margin.

canvasWidth.description: Canvas width in pixels. Layout region coordinates are absolute against this.

canvasHeight.description: Canvas height in pixels. Layout region coordinates are absolute against this.

title.description: Default geometry and styling for title regions.

body.description: Default geometry and styling for body regions.

regionDefaults.description: Default geometry, font size, and color for a region type.

x.description: Default horizontal offset in pixels from the canvas origin.

y.description: Default vertical offset in pixels from the canvas origin.

fontFamily.description: Font family override. When unset, inherits `metadata.defaults.fontFamily`.

color.description: Default semantic color resolved from PresentationColorTheme.

region.description: A single addressable content area within a slide layout.

id.description: Region identifier referenced by a slide's content blocks.

x.description: Horizontal offset in pixels from the canvas origin.

y.description: Vertical offset in pixels from the canvas origin.

fontFamily.description: Font family override. When unset, inherits `metadata.defaults.fontFamily`.

color.description: Semantic color name resolved from PresentationColorTheme.

overflow.description: Behavior when content exceeds the region box. 'wrap' flows text within the box; 'clip' truncates at the boundary; 'shrink' deterministically reduces font size within the bounds declared by minFontSize/maxLines/scaleLadder.

minFontSize.description: Responsive fit budget (R15): the smallest font size in points the renderer may shrink to under overflow 'shrink'. No default -- absence means no responsive budget.

maxLines.description: Responsive fit budget (R15): the maximum number of lines the renderer may use when shrinking under overflow 'shrink'. Also the layout capacity bound (R20) consumed by the downstream design-lint tier -- one field, two consumers, per the single-definition rule. No default -- absence means no responsive budget / no capacity bound.

scaleLadder.description: Responsive fit budget (R15): an optional array of descending font sizes in points the renderer steps through under overflow 'shrink', never going below minFontSize. No default -- absence means no responsive budget.

lineSpacing.description: Paragraph rhythm (R16): line spacing multiplier for text in this region, e.g. 1.15 for 115%. No default -- absence means the renderer chooses.

spaceBefore.description: Paragraph rhythm (R16): space in pixels added before each paragraph in this region. No default -- absence means the renderer chooses.

spaceAfter.description: Paragraph rhythm (R16): space in pixels added after each paragraph in this region. No default -- absence means the renderer chooses.

valueStyle.description: Metric style roles (R17): style override for a metric region's headline value field. Reuses the existing style shape (R2) rather than re-declaring it. No default -- absence means the renderer chooses.

labelStyle.description: Metric style roles (R17): style override for a metric region's label field. Reuses the existing style shape (R2) rather than re-declaring it. No default -- absence means the renderer chooses.

deltaStyle.description: Metric style roles (R17): style override for a metric region's delta field. Reuses the existing style shape (R2) rather than re-declaring it. No default -- absence means the renderer chooses.

metricGap.description: Metric style roles (R17): inter-field gap in pixels between a metric region's value/label/delta fields. No default -- absence means the renderer chooses.

labelPermitted.description: Metric style roles (R17): whether a metric region's label field is permitted. No default -- absence means permitted.

deltaPermitted.description: Metric style roles (R17): whether a metric region's delta field is permitted. No default -- absence means permitted.

preferredAspectRatio.description: Media fit and aspect (R18): the region's preferred width/height ratio for media content, e.g. 1.778 for 16:9. Defined once here -- R20 (layout capacity) $refs this field rather than redeclaring it. No default -- absence means no aspect preference.

minAspectRatio.description: Media fit and aspect (R18): lower bound of an acceptable width/height aspect-ratio range for media placed in this region, an alternative to a single 'preferredAspectRatio' when a range is acceptable. No default -- absence means no lower bound.

maxAspectRatio.description: Media fit and aspect (R18): upper bound of an acceptable width/height aspect-ratio range for media placed in this region. No default -- absence means no upper bound.

minFillRatio.description: Media fit and aspect (R18): minimum fraction of the region's area that placed media must fill before a downstream lint warns that a source cannot satisfy the region without an author decision. No default -- absence means no fill-ratio floor.

allowedContentTypes.description: Layout capacity and semantic roles (R20): the set of content block kinds this region accepts, reusing the block 'type' enum by reference rather than redeclaring it. Consumed by the downstream design-lint tier. No default -- absence means no content-type restriction.

occupancy.description: Layout capacity and semantic roles (R20): whether a slide using this layout must, should, or may populate this region. Consumed by the downstream design-lint tier. No default -- absence means no occupancy constraint.

maxCharacters.description: Layout capacity and semantic roles (R20): the maximum total character count this region's content may contain. Consumed by the downstream design-lint tier. No default -- absence means no character-count bound.

maxItems.description: Layout capacity and semantic roles (R20): the maximum number of list items (e.g. bullets) this region may contain. Consumed by the downstream design-lint tier. No default -- absence means no item-count bound.

maxCharactersPerItem.description: Layout capacity and semantic roles (R20): the maximum character count for any single list item in this region. Consumed by the downstream design-lint tier. No default -- absence means no per-item character bound.

role.description: Layout capacity and semantic roles (R20): the region's semantic identity, consumed by the downstream renderer for shape identity and reading order. No default -- absence means no declared semantic role.

slideLayout.description: A named, reusable arrangement of regions on the canvas.

regions.description: The regions making up this layout.

notes.description: Authoring guidance for agents or presentation generators.

purpose.description: Layout capacity and semantic roles (R20): the communication purpose tag set this layout serves, consumed by the downstream authoring skill for layout selection (not by the renderer). No default -- absence means no declared purpose.

density.description: Layout capacity and semantic roles (R20): the overall content density this layout is designed for, consumed by the downstream authoring skill for layout selection (not by the renderer). No default -- absence means no declared density class.
